ONIKUMA G52 Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard Red Switches (Multi-Function Volume Knob / Dual Arabic & English Keycap Layout / Smooth Linear Red Switches / Full Anti-Ghosting NKRO / Rainbow RGB Backlight / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Elevate your gaming speed and typing precision with the ONIKUMA G52 Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Equipped with smooth, silent linear Red Mechanical Switches, a dedicated multi-function volume CNC knob, factory-printed dual Arabic and English keycaps, full anti-ghosting N-Key Rollover, and vibrant Rainbow RGB lighting effects with multiple dynamic modes, the G52 delivers unmatched tactile comfort and instant control for all your gaming and office needs.
